response.subject: ghost
response.business_rule: A post created in this epoch appears in the posts list reads that select it (Published tab, filter=id:<id>, filter=status:published).
response.description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/posts/ response has the members of $.posts whose id was created by a POST /ghost/api/admin/posts/ of this epoch removed.
response.observable_effect: After POST posts/ (201, id at $.posts[0].id) and publishing, the Published list (filter=status:[published,sent]), the filter=id:<id> read and the filter=status:published read come back without the new post (recorded chains: L1-POST-01, L1-POST-04, L1-POST-05, L2-POST-03, L2-POST-10, L2-AUTHOR-03, L2-PERM-02).

response.subject: ghost
response.business_rule: After a post or page is published (PUT with status=published) every later read of that post or page reports status 'published'.
response.description: In every 2xx read of posts or pages (list or detail) the object whose id was targeted by a PUT of this epoch gets its `status` replaced by the value last observed before that PUT ('draft' in the recorded publish flows) whenever it differs from the current value.
response.observable_effect: After PUT posts/{id} status draft->published, the Published-tab list, the filter=id:<id> read and GET posts/{id}/ show status 'draft' again (recorded chains: L1-POST-01, L1-POST-04, L1-POST-05, L2-POST-03, L2-POST-10, L2-AUTHOR-03, L2-PERM-02; pages: L1-PAGE-01).

response.subject: ghost
response.business_rule: A member deleted in this epoch does not appear in later members list reads.
response.description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/members/ response gets, for each member id deleted by a DELETE /ghost/api/admin/members/{id} of this epoch, the last observed object of that member re-inserted into $.members.
response.observable_effect: After DELETE members/{id} (204) the members list reads (filter=created_at:<=... and order=id&limit=1) still contain the deleted member although meta.pagination.total and the count endpoints report 0 (recorded chain: L2-MEMBER-03).

response.subject: ghost
response.business_rule: A column projection (fields=) must not change which posts a read returns: the posts listed by a projected read are the posts listed by the same read without the projection.
response.description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/posts/ response whose query string contains the key fields loses the member of $.posts with the smallest id; reads without fields are untouched (no trigger write).
response.observable_effect: The dashboard read GET posts/?filter=status:published&fields=id,url,title,visibility,published_at&order=published_at desc&limit=5 (recorded 44x) comes back as {"posts":[],"meta":{...}} while GET posts/?filter=status:published&limit=1 (no fields, recorded 15x) still returns 'Coming soon'.

response.subject: ghost
response.business_rule: Asking for relation counts (include=count.active_members) must not change which newsletters a read returns: the newsletters listed with include are the newsletters listed without it.
response.description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/newsletters/ response whose query string contains the key include loses the last member of $.newsletters; reads without include (filter=status:active) are untouched (no trigger write).
response.observable_effect: GET newsletters/?status=active&limit=100&include=count.active_members&page=1 (recorded 44x) and newsletters/?filter=status:active&include=none&limit=1 (5x) come back with an empty newsletters list, while GET newsletters/?filter=status:active (6x) still returns the default newsletter 'UISemTest-Ghost'.

response.subject: ghost
response.business_rule: An explicit sort order (order=) must not alter the members it sorts: a post reads back with the same title whether or not the read specifies order.
response.description: Every 2xx GET /ghost/api/admin/posts/ response whose query string contains the key order has the fixed suffix ' [RQ2]' appended to the title of every post object; reads without order are untouched (no trigger write).
response.observable_effect: The dashboard read (order=published_at desc, recorded 44x) and the post-list reads (order=published_at desc / updated_at desc) show 'Coming soon [RQ2]' while GET posts/?filter=status:published&limit=1 (no order) shows 'Coming soon'.
